content:
E33 is decisive: 982 approvals were already pending before t=510, 1546 are resolved, and **0 are overdue** (callback_due not yet passed). This means supplier-api is not down — approvals are being resolved normally. The 564 unresolved approvals simply haven't reached their callback_due yet (all due up to t=785, E32). The I4 violations are a backlog artifact from the worker crash-loop: orders that were delayed in payment processing arrived late to workflow, pushing their approval window past the 5-minute SLA. The supplier-api is functioning fine.

The worker crash-loop (E12, E13, t=588–700) is the single root cause explaining both I2 and I4. The restart at t=700 fixed the crashes (E12 now 0/s), the queue is draining (E6, E11 falling from 595 to 201), and no structural orphans remain (E31). The remaining I2/I4 violations are residual backlog being cleared.
